question: How much does Pilates teacher training cost?
answer: Mat, Reformer and Barre teacher training each cost £2,200. That includes the online Human Movement course, the in-person days (four for Mat, five for Reformer or Barre), your manual, the video library, all workshops and all exams. There are no extra fees for assessment or certification. You can pay in full or in four monthly interest-free payments.

question: Can I pay in instalments?
answer: Yes. Mat, Reformer and Barre can be paid in four monthly interest-free payments of £550. A double booking of two courses can be spread over six payments. CPD can be paid in two instalments. All payments are non-refundable and non-transferable.

question: Is there a discount for booking two courses?
answer: Yes. Book any two of Mat, Reformer and Barre together for £3,400, a saving of £1,000, with the option of six monthly interest-free payments.

question: Is there a discount if I already hold a Level 3 fitness qualification?
answer: Students with an existing Level 3 fitness qualification receive £400 off. Email a copy of your certificate to info@thepilatesprogramme.co.uk and we will send you a discount code.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: All payments are non-refundable and non-transferable. If something changes before your course, email us as early as you can and we will do what we can to help.

question: Are there any extra costs to plan for?
answer: Exams, your manual and assessment are included. Beyond the course fee you may want to budget for studio hire for practice teaching, teacher insurance once you start teaching, and travel. Ask us for current studio hire rates.

question: How many practice hours do I need, and how do I organise them?
answer: Once your in-person days are complete you put it all into practice: 30 observation hours (watching other teachers, in person or on our online platform), 25 personal study hours (practising every exercise in the manual on your own body) and 25 practice teaching hours (planning and delivering practice classes). You complete them in your own time, at a location that works for you, around work and family. You can hire the studio at our training centre for practice teaching, observe classes locally or on our app, and teach friends, family or fellow students.

question: What are the exams like?
answer: All online and all included in the course fee. The HUMAN MOVEMENT exam is 50 multiple choice questions. The theory exam is 30 multiple choice questions on the practical application of teaching. The practical exam is a 45-minute class you plan and teach to a client you source. We structure the course so you are ready for each one.

question: How long does it take to become a Pilates instructor?
answer: It depends on you. The in-person days are four (Mat) or five (Reformer and Barre). After that you complete your practice hours in your own time, around your job, your kids and everything else in your life. Most students certify in around six months. Some do it in three, some take up to twelve, and both are fine.

question: Do I need Pilates experience to train as a Mat teacher?
answer: You do not need a prior certification, but you do need to have practised mat Pilates before you train with us. We ask for a minimum of 50 hours of class experience in your chosen apparatus, 30 of them in classical Pilates classes so you have a sound understanding of the original exercises. You can clock these up on the road to your course dates.

question: Do I need access to a Reformer to train?
answer: For the in-person days, no. For your practice hours you will need regular time on a Reformer, either at a local studio, through equipment hire at our centre, or at home. If you have no access at all, Mat may be the better first course.

question: Do I need a dance background to teach Barre?
answer: No. Barre uses ballet positions but you are training to teach conditioning, not ballet. Musicality and a love of group classes matter more than dance training.

question: Should I do Mat or Reformer first?
answer: Mat gives you the fullest foundation, works anywhere and needs no equipment for practice hours. Reformer is the format most boutique studios hire for. Many students book both as a double booking and save £1,000. If you are unsure, take the 60-second course quiz.

question: Are your courses accredited?
answer: Our Mat and Reformer teacher trainings are internationally accredited by ITTAP via the Pilates Method Alliance (PMA), an internationally recognised body committed to high standards in Pilates education. Our Barre teacher training is the only one in the UK accredited by the Barre Fitness Alliance. Our Prenatal and Postpartum CPD is endorsed by CIMSPA. The accreditation page explains what each body is and what it means for where you can teach.

question: What support do I get after I certify?
answer: You keep access to the online platform and video library, you can hire studio space and equipment at the centre, you receive 10% off further training, and our jobs board lists roles from studios across the UK. Our graduates teach across the UK and abroad, and we provide a letter of validation covering our content criteria, international alignment and insurance coverage.

question: Where do your graduates teach?
answer: Our graduates teach in boutique studios, gyms, community venues, online and in their own businesses across the UK and abroad, from Ireland and Europe to the Middle East and Australia.

question: What do I need before an apparatus course?
answer: Chair, Cadillac and Barrels require an existing Mat or Reformer teaching certification from any provider. Advanced Reformer requires an existing Reformer certification. Each course includes its manual, exam, an interest-free payment plan and online platform access with a 6-week free trial.

question: How does the apparatus bundle work?
answer: Book Cadillac, Chair and Barrels together for £2,700 and Barrels is included free. You attend each course on its scheduled dates.

question: Is there a discount for past students?
answer: Yes. Past graduates receive 10% off further training and CPD. Email us with the course you trained on and we will send your code.

question: Can I attend CPD if I trained elsewhere?
answer: Yes. CPD days are open to certified Pilates and Barre teachers from any provider.

question: How does the online CPD work?
answer: The Jumpboard CPD is on demand. After booking you receive access to the videos and notes and can complete it in your own time.

question: Can I pay for CPD in instalments?
answer: Yes. Every continuing education course, apparatus and CPD, can be paid in full or in two interest-free instalments. The manual, exams or assessment, and online platform access with a 6-week free trial are included in the price. All payments are non-refundable and non-transferable.

question: Where is the training centre?
answer: 23 Central Way, Altrincham, WA14 1RF, a short walk from Altrincham train and tram interchange with parking nearby. The centre has two floors with full apparatus and Barre fit-out, seminar screens, study spaces and a kitchen. Most courses run here. Around half a dozen a year run elsewhere in the UK and abroad, and the course dates page shows where.

question: Can I hire the studio for practice hours?
answer: Yes. Students can hire the studio and equipment at the centre for practice teaching and personal practice. Ask us for current rates.

question: Do you run weekend courses?
answer: Current cohorts run on weekdays. Check the course dates page for the latest schedule, or get notified when new dates are released.
